svg.title: Checkers: game 6, move 11
svg.desc: Game 6 of @tannergolden against GitHub, after 10... 20x11: man from 20 jumps 16, landing on 11. It is GitHub's turn as Black, and a jump must be taken, due by 18 Oct. @tannergolden, White: men on 11, 21, 24, 25, 27, 28, 29, 30, 32; GitHub, Black: men on 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 14, 18.
